title: The Trials of Dan and Dave

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: This is the story of an ad campaign produced for the 1992 Olympic Games in Barcelona.
sentences.zh: 这是关于1992年巴塞罗那奥运会期间制作的一则广告宣传活动的故事。

sentences.en: Perennial runner-up in the sports shoe category, Reebok, was trying to make its mark and take down Nike.
sentences.zh: 锐步（Reebok）作为运动鞋领域的常年老二，正试图打响名号，击败耐克。

sentences.en: They chose two athletes, plucked them out of obscurity, gave them Reeboks to wear, and turned them into household names, spending $25 million in the process.
sentences.zh: 他们挑选了两名运动员，将他们从默默无闻中发掘出来，让他们穿上锐步鞋，并花费2500万美元将他们打造成家喻户晓的名字。

sentences.en: That was more than Reebok's entire marketing budget the previous year.
sentences.zh: 这比锐步前一年的全部营销预算还要多。

sentences.en: This ad campaign is pretty much remembered as a disaster for Reebok, but it created From Nothing, an epic drama that pitted two world-class decathletes against each other,
sentences.zh: 这则广告宣传活动在锐步的历史上几乎被视为一场灾难，但它创造了《从零开始》（From Nothing），这是一部史诗般的戏剧，让两名世界级的十项全能运动员相互较量，

sentences.en: and it resulted in so many strange twists and turns.
sentences.zh: 并导致了许多奇怪的转折。

sentences.en: All because someone thought it was a clever way to sell shoes.
sentences.zh: 这一切仅仅是因为有人认为这是一种推销鞋子的聪明方法。

sentences.en: I love this story.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个故事。

sentences.en: This is the first episode of 30 for 30 Podcasts, which are original audio documentaries from ESPN.
sentences.zh: 这是《30 for 30》播客的第一集，这是ESPN制作的原创音频纪录片。

sentences.en: Again, these are stories about sports, but they're the sports stories that I like, that delve into their impact on culture, politics, and more.
sentences.zh: 同样，这些都是关于体育的故事，但它们是我喜欢的体育故事，深入探讨了它们对文化、政治等方面的影响。

sentences.en: Here's host Jody Avergan to guide you through the trials of Dan and Dave.
sentences.zh: 主持人乔迪·阿弗根将带你了解丹和戴夫的考验。

sentences.en: Live at the Metrodome in the Twin Cities of Minneapolis and St. Paul, Super Bowl number 26.
sentences.zh: 在明尼阿波利斯和圣保罗双子城的都市巨蛋体育场现场，第26届超级碗。

sentences.en: Super Bowl 26, January 26, 1992.
sentences.zh: 第26届超级碗，1992年1月26日。

sentences.en: Almost 80 million people watching on television, many of them from parties like the one at Dan O'Brien's house.
sentences.zh: 近8000万人通过电视观看，其中许多人是在像丹·奥布莱恩家那样的派对上观看的。

sentences.en: Everybody was drinking beer, and then we got into the hard alcohol, and it was really fun.
sentences.zh: 大家都在喝啤酒，后来我们开始喝烈酒，真的很有趣。

sentences.en: Dan is watching from Moscow, Idaho.
sentences.zh: 丹在爱达荷州的莫斯科观看比赛。

sentences.en: Dave Johnson is watching from Los Angeles, California.
sentences.zh: 戴夫·约翰逊在加利福尼亚州的洛杉矶观看比赛。

sentences.en: I probably had 30 or 40 people at my house with multiple TVs set up, and everybody's there, and I kind of kept it a little bit of a secret.
sentences.zh: 我家里可能有30到40个人，摆了好几台电视，大家都在那儿，我稍微保密了一点。

sentences.en: I just let them know, wait till you see what's going to be on here.
sentences.zh: 我只是告诉他们，等着瞧吧，看看接下来会播什么。

sentences.en: And so the first commercial comes on, and it's super short.
sentences.zh: 然后第一个广告出现了，非常短。

sentences.en: It's in the third quarter, just before a Pepsi ad featuring Cindy Crawford.
sentences.zh: 它在第三节，就在辛迪·克劳馥代言的百事可乐广告之前。

sentences.en: The first Dan and Dave commercial runs, featuring old photographs and grainy videos of two toddlers, Dan O'Brien and Dave Johnson.
sentences.zh: 第一则丹和戴夫的广告播出了，展示了两个蹒跚学步的孩子——丹·奥布莱恩和戴夫·约翰逊的老照片和颗粒感十足的视频。

sentences.en: The voiceover expounds on the men's athletic feats, but the visuals are just the photos of the two toddlers.
sentences.zh: 画外音阐述了这两人的运动壮举，但画面只是那两个幼儿的照片。

sentences.en: Me in a bathtub, Dave on a bike.
sentences.zh: 我在浴缸里，戴夫在骑自行车。

sentences.en: It was just little kids.
sentences.zh: 那只是小孩子。

sentences.en: And that's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: And everybody kind of looks around like, that's it?
sentences.zh: 大家都面面相觑，心想，就这样？

sentences.en: What the heck was that?
sentences.zh: 那到底是什么鬼？

sentences.en: Then, later in the same commercial break, another short ad runs.
sentences.zh: 然后，在同一个广告时段稍后，又播出了另一则短广告。

sentences.en: Dan can throw a 16-pound shot put 53 feet 3 inches.
sentences.zh: 丹可以把16磅重的铅球投出53英尺3英寸。

sentences.en: More pictures and home videos.
sentences.zh: 更多的照片和家庭录像。

sentences.en: Only in this one, the kids are a little older, maybe 5 or 6.
sentences.zh: 只是这一次，孩子们大了一点，大概5或6岁。

sentences.en: The second ad ends the same way as the firSt.
sentences.zh: 第二则广告的结尾和第一则一样。

sentences.en: A quick Reebok logo and a promise.
sentences.zh: 一个快速闪过的锐步标志和一个承诺。

sentences.en: This summer, they'll battle it out in Barcelona for the title of world's greatest athlete.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天，他们将在巴塞罗那争夺世界最伟大运动员的称号。

sentences.en: I didn't know what to expect.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该期待什么。

sentences.en: They didn't show us the commercials before we saw them at the Super Bowl.
sentences.zh: 在超级碗看到这些广告之前，他们并没有给我们看。

sentences.en: Reebok ran two more commercials, making four in total, all during the third quarter.
sentences.zh: 锐步又播出了两则广告，总共四则，全部在第三节播出。

sentences.en: And all of them, just 15 seconds long.
sentences.zh: 而且每一则都只有15秒长。

sentences.en: Dan won the decathlon at the World Track and Field Championships.
sentences.zh: 丹赢得了世界田径锦标赛的十项全能冠军。

sentences.en: Dave won the decathlon at the Goodwill Games.
sentences.zh: 戴夫赢得了友好运动会的十项全能冠军。

sentences.en: This summer, they'll battle it out in Barcelona for the title of world's greatest athlete.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天，他们将在巴塞罗那争夺世界最伟大运动员的称号。

sentences.en: I remember people really being confused at first, and then eventually they were going,
sentences.zh: 我记得人们起初真的很困惑，然后最终他们开始说，

sentences.en: man, that is genius.
sentences.zh: 天哪，这真是天才之作。

sentences.en: They were talking about how amazing that Reebok thought of doing small little commercials
sentences.zh: 他们谈论着锐步想到制作这些小广告是多么了不起，

sentences.en: all the way to where there's a culmination of what they really were talking about.
sentences.zh: 一直到他们真正想要表达的内容达到高潮。

sentences.en: And that's these two athletes that are going to go to the Olympics this year,
sentences.zh: 那就是这两位今年要去参加奥运会的运动员，

sentences.en: and it's going to be settled in Barcelona.
sentences.zh: 一切都将在巴塞罗那见分晓。

sentences.en: By the way, the game, it's pretty lame, with Washington beating Buffalo 37-24.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，比赛本身挺无聊的，华盛顿队以37比24击败了布法罗队。

sentences.en: But the ads have made their impact.
sentences.zh: 但这些广告已经产生了影响。

sentences.en: When the Super Bowl was over and the party was over, and everybody got out of there,
sentences.zh: 当超级碗结束，派对结束，大家都离开之后，

sentences.en: and it was a little bit shocking, really.
sentences.zh: 这真的有点令人震惊。

sentences.en: It's like, wow, we're here to celebrate commercials that I was in.
sentences.zh: 就像是，哇，我们在这里庆祝我参与拍摄的广告。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I remember sitting with a group of people that I had there, and they were all kind of going,
sentences.zh: 我记得我和我请来的一群人坐在一起，他们都有点在说，

sentences.en: I can't believe I'm sitting, that we're here with Dave.
sentences.zh: 真不敢相信我正坐在这里，我们正和戴夫在一起。

sentences.en: And I never really thought of myself that way, that somebody would think it's cool to be with Dave.
sentences.zh: 我从来没想过自己会那样，会有人觉得和戴夫在一起很酷。

sentences.en: That was the first time I really sat there and was going, you know, people are going to know who I am now.
sentences.zh: 那是我第一次真正坐在那里心想，你知道，现在人们会知道我是谁了。

sentences.en: And I remember almost being scared, you know, what do you do with that?
sentences.zh: 我记得当时甚至有点害怕，你知道，你该怎么处理这个？

sentences.en: In 92, Reebok was known primarily as a shoe that your mom wore to take aerobics classes in.
sentences.zh: 在92年，锐步主要被认为是妈妈们穿去上健美操课的鞋子。

sentences.en: And they were desperate to increase their athletic credibility.
sentences.zh: 他们迫切想要提升自己的运动可信度。

sentences.en: In 92, Rick Sittig worked for Chayette Day, the ad agency hired to put together Reebok's latest campaign.
sentences.zh: 92年，里克·西蒂格在Chiat/Day广告公司工作，该公司受聘负责锐步的最新宣传活动。

sentences.en: Reebok!
sentences.zh: 锐步！

sentences.en: The task was pretty daunting.
sentences.zh: 这项任务相当艰巨。

sentences.en: We've got two guys no one's ever heard of in an event no one really cares about.
sentences.zh: 我们有两个没人听说过的家伙，参加一项没人真正在意的赛事。

sentences.en: All of the best-known athletes were Nike athletes, the Michael Jordans of the world,
sentences.zh: 所有最著名的运动员都是耐克旗下的，比如迈克尔·乔丹之流，

sentences.en: the most famous professional athletes in the world.
sentences.zh: 世界上最著名的职业运动员。

sentences.en: If we wanted to stand out, we needed to do something else.
sentences.zh: 如果我们想脱颖而出，就必须做点别的。

sentences.en: The basic idea was, in sports circles, the winner of the decathlon is the world's greatest athlete.
sentences.zh: 基本理念是，在体育圈里，十项全能的获胜者就是世界上最伟大的运动员。

sentences.en: And so, it wasn't hard for Reebok to get excited about a campaign that said,
sentences.zh: 所以，锐步很容易对一个打出这样的口号的宣传活动感到兴奋：

sentences.en: who's the world's greatest athlete?
sentences.zh: 谁是世界上最伟大的运动员？

sentences.en: This Reebok athlete you've never heard of?
sentences.zh: 这个你从未听说过的锐步运动员？

sentences.en: Or this other Reebok athlete you've never heard of?
sentences.zh: 还是这个你从未听说过的另一个锐步运动员？

sentences.en: The decathlon, by nature, is, in my opinion, the toughest of all the track and field events.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，十项全能本质上是所有田径项目中难度最大的。

sentences.en: The decathlon is so tough because it combines so much.
sentences.zh: 十项全能之所以如此艰难，是因为它结合了太多的项目。

sentences.en: It's 10 events contested over the course of two days, each one adding to the competitor's overall point total.
sentences.zh: 它是在两天内进行的10个项目，每一项都计入选手的总分。

sentences.en: Day one is the 100-meter dash, long jump, shot put, high jump, and the 400-meter run.
sentences.zh: 第一天是100米短跑、跳远、铅球、跳高和400米跑。

sentences.en: Day two is the 110-meter hurdles, discus, pole vault, javelin, and last, the 1,500-meter run.
sentences.zh: 第二天是110米栏、铁饼、撑杆跳高、标枪，最后是1500米跑。

sentences.en: And it attracts some really interesting individuals.
sentences.zh: 它吸引了一些非常有趣的人。

sentences.en: We don't say that athletes find the decathlon.
sentences.zh: 我们不说运动员寻找十项全能。

sentences.en: We say that the decathlon will find those athletes.
sentences.zh: 我们说十项全能会找到那些运动员。

sentences.en: That's what happened to me.
sentences.zh: 这就是发生在我身上的事。

sentences.en: I think that's what happened to Dave.
sentences.zh: 我想戴夫也是这样。

sentences.en: Born in 1963, Dave Johnson grew up in Montana and Oregon.
sentences.zh: 戴夫·约翰逊出生于1963年，在蒙大拿州和俄勒冈州长大。

sentences.en: By his own admission, he was hardly the model young man.
sentences.zh: 据他自己承认，他绝不是模范青年。

sentences.en: I was one of those kids that was in a lot of trouble growing up.
sentences.zh: 我小时候是个经常惹麻烦的孩子。

sentences.en: I was actually throwing snowballs at cars, and I think I did definitely learn how to throw so well
sentences.zh: 我实际上会朝汽车扔雪球，我想我确实学会了如何扔得那么准，

sentences.en: because I was able to stand farther back than anybody else and throw that apple or throw that snowball, throw that rock.
sentences.zh: 因为我能比任何人都站得远，然后扔出那个苹果、那个雪球或那块石头。

sentences.en: I remember the first time a coach told me what the decathlon was.
sentences.zh: 我记得第一次有教练告诉我什么是十项全能。

sentences.en: He said, you should do the decathlon.
sentences.zh: 他说，你应该参加十项全能。

sentences.en: I thought he said marathon.
sentences.zh: 我以为他说的是马拉松。

sentences.en: I was like, Coach, no, I'm the hurdler.
sentences.zh: 我说，教练，不，我是跨栏运动员。

sentences.en: I don't run distance.
sentences.zh: 我不跑长距离。

sentences.en: And he goes, no, no, the decathlon.
sentences.zh: 他说，不，不，是十项全能。

sentences.en: He said, do you know Bruce Jenner?
sentences.zh: 他说，你认识布鲁斯·詹纳吗？

sentences.en: And I go, well, Bruce Jenner, that's a guy on chips.
sentences.zh: 我说，嗯，布鲁斯·詹纳，那是薯片广告里的人吧。

sentences.en: I remember watching television.
sentences.zh: 我记得我看过电视。

sentences.en: There was Jenner was on a show called Chips at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时詹纳在一部叫《加州公路巡警》（CHiPs）的剧里。

sentences.en: He was doing a cameo with them.
sentences.zh: 他在里面客串。

sentences.en: And so I just knew him as a Hollywood TV guy.
sentences.zh: 所以我只知道他是个好莱坞电视明星。

sentences.en: And he said, no, that's, you know, he was an Olympic medaliSt.
sentences.zh: 他说，不，那是，你知道，他曾是奥运奖牌得主。

sentences.en: Dave Johnson was hooked.
sentences.zh: 戴夫·约翰逊被迷住了。

sentences.en: Dan O'Brien also grew up in Oregon, just a few hours south of Dave.
sentences.zh: 丹·奥布莱恩也在俄勒冈州长大，就在戴夫南边几个小时车程的地方。

sentences.en: Near the small town of Klamath Falls.
sentences.zh: 靠近克拉马斯福尔斯小镇。

sentences.en: And he also had his ups and downs before finding his sport.
sentences.zh: 在找到自己的运动项目之前，他也经历过起起落落。

sentences.en: Well, growing up in Southern Oregon, to me, always felt like I was out of place.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在俄勒冈州南部长大，对我来说，总觉得我格格不入。

sentences.en: You know, we had six adopted kids in the family.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们家里有六个领养的孩子。

sentences.en: I have a sister who's biracial like myself, a little brother who's Hispanic.
sentences.zh: 我有一个像我一样是混血儿的姐姐，还有一个拉美裔的弟弟。

sentences.en: I have a Native American sister and then two Korean sisters.
sentences.zh: 我有一个美洲原住民姐姐，还有两个韩国姐姐。

sentences.en: Well, when you're the only kid of color or kids of color in your entire town, which the O'Brien family was, you know,
sentences.zh: 嗯，当你所在的整个城镇里只有你一个有色人种孩子，或者只有你们几个有色人种孩子时，就像奥布莱恩一家那样，你知道，

sentences.en: it's interesting because all you want to do when you're young is fit in.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为当你年轻时，你只想融入其中。

sentences.en: And blend in, blend in, go along, get along.
sentences.zh: 随大流，融入，顺从，相处融洽。

sentences.en: And there we are looking like the Rainbow Coalition.
sentences.zh: 而我们看起来就像个“彩虹联盟”。

sentences.en: Every time we get out of the car and go to church, the movies, it's a very weird feeling when everybody's watching you.
sentences.zh: 每次我们下车去教堂、看电影，当每个人都在盯着你看时，那是一种非常奇怪的感觉。

sentences.en: And I can just remember thinking, you know, why are people staring at me?
sentences.zh: 我记得我当时心想，你知道，为什么人们盯着我看？

sentences.en: Why are people staring at us?
sentences.zh: 为什么人们盯着我们看？

sentences.en: This is just our regular family.
sentences.zh: 这只是我们普通的家庭。

sentences.en: And it wasn't until I got into sports that I really felt like I belonged.
sentences.zh: 直到我开始参加体育运动，我才真正觉得我属于这里。

sentences.en: I always thought that sports was the equalizer for me.
sentences.zh: 我一直认为体育对我来说是平等的调节器。

sentences.en: Didn't matter what you looked like or where you came from.
sentences.zh: 不管你长什么样，或者你来自哪里。

sentences.en: If you were good at sports, you were good.
sentences.zh: 如果你擅长体育，你就是优秀的。

sentences.en: And Dan was good.
sentences.zh: 而丹很优秀。

sentences.en: He became a star athlete in high school, landed a scholarship at the University of Idaho, and there started to compete in the decathlon.
sentences.zh: 他在高中成为了一名明星运动员，获得了爱达荷大学的奖学金，并从那里开始参加十项全能比赛。

sentences.en: And in his senior year, 1988, he first crossed paths with Dave Johnson, a few years older and already well-established on the scene.
sentences.zh: 在大四那年，即1988年，他第一次与戴夫·约翰逊相遇，戴夫比他大几岁，已经在圈内很有名气了。

sentences.en: You know, Dave was the best American up until that point.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在那之前，戴夫是美国最优秀的选手。

sentences.en: But Dan's star was rising quickly, and others in the tight-knit track community were starting to notice.
sentences.zh: 但丹的明星光芒正在迅速升起，紧密团结的田径界的其他人也开始注意到这一点。

sentences.en: I'm Jackie Joyner-Kersey, the world's greatest female athlete.
sentences.zh: 我是杰基·乔伊娜-克西，世界上最伟大的女运动员。

sentences.en: Jackie Joyner-Kersey can say that, even now, thanks to her six Olympic medals and the heptathlon world record she set in 1988 that still stands today.
sentences.zh: 杰基·乔伊娜-克西即使在今天也能这么说，这要归功于她的六枚奥运奖牌和她在1988年创下的至今仍未被打破的七项全能世界纪录。

sentences.en: When you see this young talent, it's just a matter of time they're going to have this big breakthrough.
sentences.zh: 当你看到这种年轻的天才时，他们取得重大突破只是时间问题。

sentences.en: Well, it's interesting, Jackie Joyner-Kersey made the comment that I could be the next Bruce Jenner.
sentences.zh: 嗯，很有趣，杰基·乔伊娜-克西评论说我可以成为下一个布鲁斯·詹纳。

sentences.en: And that was what I was striving to do, you know, most of my career.
sentences.zh: 那也是我职业生涯大部分时间里努力想要做到的，你知道。

sentences.en: He was the hero that we all needed in 1976, and he was the golden boy.
sentences.zh: 他是我们在1976年所需要的英雄，他是金童。

sentences.en: And Dan was that very explosive athlete.
sentences.zh: 而丹就是那种非常有爆发力的运动员。

sentences.en: I mean, he was just this young kid, very raw, you know, very talkative, and he had a personality that could pull people to him.

sentences.zh: 在巴塞罗那见分晓。

sentences.en: decathlon.
sentences.zh: 十项全能。

sentences.en: Any coach will tell you that's where they're the most worried.
sentences.zh: 任何教练都会告诉你，那是他们最担心的地方。

sentences.en: In the pole vault, competitors aim to clear increasing heights one by one.
sentences.zh: 在撑杆跳高比赛中，选手们的目标是依次越过不断升高的高度。

sentences.en: The higher the bar, the more points received.
sentences.zh: 横杆越高，得分就越高。

sentences.en: Each vaulter gets three attempts on a given height.
sentences.zh: 每位选手在同一高度有三次试跳机会。

sentences.en: And each can choose whatever height they'd like to start at.
sentences.zh: 而且每个人都可以选择自己想要开始挑战的高度。

sentences.en: But if they fail to clear the bar at the first height, they get no points.
sentences.zh: 但如果他们在第一个高度就试跳失败，就无法得分。

sentences.en: To start earning relatively high points immediately, Dan and Dave made the same aggressive choice.
sentences.zh: 为了能尽快获得相对较高的分数，丹和戴夫做出了同样激进的选择。

sentences.en: To begin their vault at 15 feet 9 inches.
sentences.zh: 从15英尺9英寸的高度开始他们的撑杆跳。

sentences.en: The higher vaulters, it takes a while to get to your turn to vault at your starting height.
sentences.zh: 对于排名靠后的选手来说，要等到轮到自己去跳起始高度，需要花上一段时间。

sentences.en: So you warm up, and they might give you a few other warm-ups, but it's never enough.
sentences.zh: 所以你会热身，他们可能会让你做几次额外的热身，但这永远不够。

sentences.en: It's the eighth event.
sentences.zh: 这是第八个项目。

sentences.en: You're feeling your legs a little bit.
sentences.zh: 你的双腿已经有点感觉了。

sentences.en: And the sun was really starting to get hot.
sentences.zh: 而且太阳真的开始变得火辣了。

sentences.en: While we're sitting around, the cameras are in our faces.
sentences.zh: 当我们坐在那里休息时，摄像机就怼在我们的脸上。

sentences.en: They're following us wherever we go.
sentences.zh: 无论我们走到哪里，他们都跟着。

sentences.en: And I remember just thinking how distracting that was.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时就在想，这有多让人分心。

sentences.en: Well, by the time the warm-ups ended, it was almost two solid hours till I took my first jump.
sentences.zh: 嗯，等到热身结束时，距离我第一次试跳已经过去了整整两个小时。

sentences.en: I vaulted firSt.
sentences.zh: 我先跳的。

sentences.en: I remember that.
sentences.zh: 我记得这一点。

sentences.en: And so I made my first height and had no problem with it, other than my foot was still getting more and more sore.
sentences.zh: 所以我第一次试跳成功了，没出什么问题，只是我的脚越来越疼了。

sentences.en: Sat down and, you know, I was battling the heat again.
sentences.zh: 坐下来，你知道，我再次与酷热作斗争。

sentences.en: And I remember seeing his first attempt at that same height.
sentences.zh: 我记得看到他第一次尝试同样的高度。

sentences.en: You know, once they call my name, I kind of look down the runway, kind of assess the wind, look over at the coach.
sentences.zh: 你知道，一旦他们叫到我的名字，我就会顺着跑道看一眼，评估一下风向，看看教练。

sentences.en: He gives me a thumbs up.
sentences.zh: 他向我竖起大拇指。

sentences.en: All I remember is putting my hands up way too late.
sentences.zh: 我只记得我举起手的时间太晚了。

sentences.en: And so literally, I just went straight up and straight down with hardly any bend in the pole.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，我只是直上直下，撑杆几乎没有任何弯曲。

sentences.en: He looked like he'd never vaulted before.
sentences.zh: 他看起来就像从来没练过撑杆跳一样。

sentences.en: It's just something was way wrong than I'd ever seen him have.
sentences.zh: 那感觉就像是出了什么大问题，是我从未在他身上见过的。

sentences.en: And so on my next attempt, I make all the adjustments, come down the runway, good takeoff, good plant.
sentences.zh: 所以下一次尝试时，我做了所有调整，跑向起跳点，起跳很好，插杆也很到位。

sentences.en: I feel like I'm way over the bar and I come down on it slightly and the bar falls off.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我已经完全越过了横杆，但身体稍微碰了一下，横杆就掉了下来。

sentences.en: And then I start to think, it's like, oh no, I'm on a third attempt.
sentences.zh: 然后我开始想，糟了，这是第三次试跳了。

sentences.en: You don't want to be on a third attempt at an opening bar, at an Olympic trials.
sentences.zh: 在奥运选拔赛上，你绝不想在起跳高度就用到第三次机会。

sentences.en: That's when I sat up and I was going, well, what is going on here?
sentences.zh: 那时我坐起来，心想，这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: And it was kind of a, there was kind of a quiet in the stands.
sentences.zh: 看台上有一种安静的气氛。

sentences.en: There wasn't as much, Dan, Dave, Dan, Dave, Dan, Dave.
sentences.zh: 不再有那么多的“丹、戴夫，丹、戴夫，丹、戴夫”的呼喊声了。

sentences.en: You kind of see the crowd begin to stir a little bit.
sentences.zh: 你能看到人群开始有些骚动。

sentences.en: Other athletes sit up and they look over your direction.
sentences.zh: 其他运动员也坐了起来，看向你的方向。

sentences.en: Ooh, Brian's got two misses.
sentences.zh: 噢，布莱恩已经两次试跳失败了。

sentences.en: This is opening bar.
sentences.zh: 这可是起跳高度啊。

sentences.en: Is that his opener?
sentences.zh: 那是他的起跳高度吗？

sentences.en: Oh, did he make one?
sentences.zh: 噢，他成功过一次吗？

sentences.en: No, I thought I saw him make one.
sentences.zh: 不，我以为我看到他成功过一次。

sentences.en: Then you hear the people talking in the crowd as well.
sentences.zh: 然后你也能听到人群中的议论声。

sentences.en: It's like, no, no, he made one.
sentences.zh: 就像是，不，不，他成功过一次。

sentences.en: I saw him make one about an hour ago.
sentences.zh: 我大约一小时前看到他成功过一次。

sentences.en: No, that was a warmup.
sentences.zh: 不，那是热身。

sentences.en: This third attempt, he might have taken a little run and then stopped and went back.
sentences.zh: 这第三次尝试，他可能跑了一小段然后停下来又退回去了。

sentences.en: This is his third and final attempt.
sentences.zh: 这是他第三次，也是最后一次机会。

sentences.en: And he goes down the runway and stops.
sentences.zh: 他跑向跑道，然后停了下来。

sentences.en: As soon as I start my run on the third attempt, I get a big gust of wind coming from the right.
sentences.zh: 就在我第三次尝试开始助跑时，我感觉到一阵大风从右侧吹来。

sentences.en: And so I stop.
sentences.zh: 所以我停了下来。

sentences.en: He just didn't look confident.
sentences.zh: 他看起来一点也不自信。

sentences.en: This is it.
sentences.zh: 就是现在了。

sentences.en: He's not on the team if he doesn't make this height.
sentences.zh: 如果他跳不过这个高度，他就进不了国家队。

sentences.en: And he knows it and it's going through his mind.
sentences.zh: 他心里很清楚，这念头一直在他脑海里盘旋。

sentences.en: I just tell myself, settle down, just relax, just relax.
sentences.zh: 我只是告诉自己，冷静下来，放松，放松。

sentences.en: And so I get back there and I take off and down the runway I go.
sentences.zh: 所以我回到起点，起跑，沿着跑道冲了过去。

sentences.en: There's a look on his face like, I'm just going to go and I'll make sure I make it.
sentences.zh: 他脸上的表情仿佛在说，我一定要冲过去，我一定要成功。

sentences.en: And I feel pretty good.
sentences.zh: 我感觉还不错。

sentences.en: I plant the pole.
sentences.zh: 我插杆起跳。

sentences.en: The next thing you know, I'm stalled out on the top and I'm looking at the bar and I think, get over it somehow.
sentences.zh: 接下来你就会发现，我在最高点停滞了，看着横杆，心想，无论如何都要翻过去。

sentences.en: And I can't.
sentences.zh: 但我做不到。

sentences.en: And it's not even close.
sentences.zh: 而且差得远呢。

sentences.en: I come crashing down to the pit and I'm just in a daze.
sentences.zh: 我重重地摔进垫子里，整个人都懵了。

sentences.en: I'm just, what happened?
sentences.zh: 我只是在想，发生了什么？

sentences.en: And at that moment, you just, I wanted to turn to somebody and say, help me.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，你只想转向某个人说，帮帮我。

sentences.en: It was almost if the sun, all that heat, that it became cloudy and it became dark.
sentences.zh: 仿佛太阳，那所有的酷热，突然变得阴云密布，天色暗了下来。

sentences.en: Because you knew something bad had happened.
sentences.zh: 因为你知道发生了糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: I blew a chance to go to the Olympic Games.
sentences.zh: 我搞砸了参加奥运会的机会。

sentences.en: I'm not on this Olympic team.
sentences.zh: 我进不了这支奥运代表队了。

sentences.en: It was, it was devastating.
sentences.zh: 这真是，真是毁灭性的打击。

sentences.en: I was devastated.
sentences.zh: 我彻底崩溃了。

sentences.en: I just tried to get away from people.
sentences.zh: 我只想躲开人群。

sentences.en: But there's guys with cameras, there's people.
sentences.zh: 但到处都是扛着摄像机的人，到处都是人。

sentences.en: And so I cried that I didn't make the team.
sentences.zh: 所以我哭了，因为我没能入选国家队。

sentences.en: I cried that I let everybody down.
sentences.zh: 我哭了，因为我让所有人失望了。

sentences.en: I was kind of in a daze, just, you know, kind of freaked out by all of it.
sentences.zh: 我当时有点恍惚，你知道，被这一切吓坏了。

sentences.en: The thought never, ever crossed my mind that day in our day, we're not making that Olympic team.
sentences.zh: 在那一天，在我们的时代，我从未想过我们进不了奥运代表队。

sentences.en: I mean, that just wasn't a thought.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那根本不在考虑范围内。

sentences.en: My main goal is to win an Olympic gold medal here.
sentences.zh: 我的主要目标是在这里赢得奥运金牌。

sentences.en: And that was what my coaches and I thought all along.
sentences.zh: 这正是我的教练和我一直以来的想法。

sentences.en: And we were so not ready for it.
sentences.zh: 我们完全没有准备好面对这个结果。

sentences.en: We're not, we were not ready to fail.
sentences.zh: 我们没有，我们没有准备好失败。

sentences.en: To not make this team.
sentences.zh: 没能入选这支队伍。

sentences.en: To not win this meet.
sentences.zh: 没能赢得这场比赛。

sentences.en: It was hard.
sentences.zh: 这太难了。

sentences.en: Everybody was still in disbelief.
sentences.zh: 每个人都还处于难以置信的状态中。

sentences.en: There was, you know, you could hear the buzz in the stands.
sentences.zh: 你可以听到看台上的议论声。

sentences.en: Oh my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: I can't believe it.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: You are the best athlete in the world.
sentences.zh: 你是世界上最优秀的运动员。

sentences.en: And I knew it was hard to deal with, dealing with all the commercials and all the hype and everything that went into it.
sentences.zh: 我知道这很难处理，要应付所有的广告、所有的炒作以及所有随之而来的事情。

sentences.en: It was too much.
sentences.zh: 这太多了。

sentences.en: It was a lot to have to deal with all at once.
sentences.zh: 要同时应对这一切实在太难了。

sentences.en: And the first thing I thought about is, you got to get to him and tell him it's going to be okay.
sentences.zh: 我首先想到的是，你得去找他，告诉他一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: Because I cared about him as a person.
sentences.zh: 因为我把他当作朋友关心。

sentences.en: You know, we were Dan and Dave, singular.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们是“丹和戴夫”，一个整体。

sentences.en: And everywhere we went, we had to be that person.
sentences.zh: 无论我们走到哪里，我们都必须扮演那个角色。

sentences.en: It was one of those things where, dang, the perfect situation wasn't happening.
sentences.zh: 这就像是，该死，完美的情况并没有发生。

sentences.en: The exact thing that would have been what everybody wanted to see wasn't going to happen.
sentences.zh: 每个人都想看到的那个结果并没有出现。

sentences.en: Suddenly, I was alone.
sentences.zh: 突然间，我独自一人了。

sentences.en: Dave Johnson.
sentences.zh: 戴夫·约翰逊。

sentences.en: Now all alone.
sentences.zh: 现在孤身一人。

sentences.en: No more Dan and Dave.
sentences.zh: 不再有“丹和戴夫”了。

sentences.en: Dave Johnson.
sentences.zh: 戴夫·约翰逊。

sentences.en: You know, I was able to become Dave again.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我又能变回戴夫了。

sentences.en: The real Dave, not the Dave Reebok.
sentences.zh: 真正的戴夫，而不是那个“锐步戴夫”。

sentences.en: Johnson in the javelin competition.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊在标枪比赛中。

sentences.en: Knows he's thrown a beauty right here.
sentences.zh: 知道他刚才投出了漂亮的一掷。

sentences.en: It turns out to be an American record of 244 feet.
sentences.zh: 结果创下了244英尺的美国纪录。

sentences.en: Dave places first in the overall competition.
sentences.zh: 戴夫在总成绩中排名第一。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Dan fails to qualify.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，丹未能获得参赛资格。

sentences.en: And they share an emotional embrace when it was over.
sentences.zh: 比赛结束后，他们深情拥抱在一起。

sentences.en: Dave came over and said, I love you, man.
sentences.zh: 戴夫走过来对我说，我爱你，伙计。

sentences.en: I love you, man.
sentences.zh: 我爱你，伙计。

sentences.en: You're going to be all right.
sentences.zh: 你会没事的。

sentences.en: I just decided he needed a hug.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得他需要一个拥抱。

sentences.en: Give him a big hug and just said, I'm so sorry that that happened.
sentences.zh: 给了他一个大大的拥抱，然后说，我很抱歉发生了这样的事。

sentences.en: And I just, I couldn't even hug him back.
sentences.zh: 我当时甚至无法回抱他。

sentences.en: You know, it was just kind of hands on my side.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的手只是垂在身体两侧。

sentences.en: It's just like, what the heck just happened?
sentences.zh: 就像是，到底发生了什么鬼？

sentences.en: For the next 48 hours, I walked around in a daze.
sentences.zh: 接下来的48小时里，我一直处于恍惚状态。

sentences.en: And I didn't think much about Dan and Dave.
sentences.zh: 我没怎么想“丹和戴夫”的事。

sentences.en: Some people asked me, well, what's Reebok going to do?
sentences.zh: 有些人问我，锐步打算怎么办？

sentences.en: And at the time, I thought, I don't care.
sentences.zh: 当时我想，我不在乎。

sentences.en: But I got the real sense that, you know, somebody's just getting yelled at somewhere.
sentences.zh: 但我确实感觉到，你知道，某处有人正在挨骂。

sentences.en: There was probably some yelling going on at the ad agency.
sentences.zh: 广告公司那边可能正在大发雷霆。

sentences.en: Rick Sittig was watching the events that afternoon on television from New York.
sentences.zh: 那天下午，里克·西蒂格正在纽约通过电视观看比赛。

sentences.en: So it's a bad situation.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个糟糕的情况。

sentences.en: The mood at the agency is just, oh, crap.
sentences.zh: 公司里的气氛就是，噢，该死。

sentences.en: Reebok has made a huge investment in these athletes to pump up their credibility in the athletic world.
sentences.zh: 锐步在这些运动员身上投入了巨资，以提升他们在体育界的信誉。

sentences.en: And they've got media to fill.
sentences.zh: 而且他们还有媒体任务要完成。

sentences.en: And the future of the company is kind of resting on the outcome of this.
sentences.zh: 公司的未来在某种程度上取决于比赛的结果。

sentences.en: And it's now just gone to hell.
sentences.zh: 现在一切都搞砸了。

sentences.en: And in my head, I'm going, oh, no.
sentences.zh: 我脑子里在想，噢，不。

sentences.en: We were planning to be on Johnny Carson.
sentences.zh: 我们原本计划去上约翰尼·卡森的节目。

sentences.en: We were planning to be hosting Saturday Night Live.
sentences.zh: 我们原本计划去主持《周六夜现场》。

sentences.en: All those commercials they'd already made.
sentences.zh: 所有那些他们已经拍好的广告。

sentences.en: They'd made 10 or 15 commercials that were going to play during the Olympic Games with Dan and Dave there.
sentences.zh: 他们拍了10到15个广告，准备在奥运会期间播放，主角就是丹和戴夫。

sentences.en: Steve Miller from Nike was in New Orleans with a few of his colleagues in a small section of seats in the middle of the stands watching the drama play out.
sentences.zh: 耐克的史蒂夫·米勒和几位同事当时也在新奥尔良，坐在看台中间的一小块区域观看这场戏剧性的比赛。

sentences.en: Sitting in the stands and watching it was, you know, it was like a dream come true.
sentences.zh: 坐在看台上看着这一切，你知道，就像梦想成真一样。

sentences.en: For months, Steve and Nike had been secretly fantasizing this exact scenario.
sentences.zh: 几个月来，史蒂夫和耐克一直私下里幻想的就是这个场景。

sentences.en: Yeah, we were actively hoping that something bad would happen.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们一直在积极地希望发生点什么糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I don't know how else to put it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道还能怎么说。

sentences.en: But I'd like to lie and say, no, it didn't make a difference.
sentences.zh: 但我很想撒谎说，不，这没什么影响。

sentences.en: But it made a difference, of course.
sentences.zh: 但当然有影响。

sentences.en: The truth is, we were just f***ing happy.
sentences.zh: 事实是，我们当时真是他妈的高兴坏了。

sentences.en: What are you going to say?
sentences.zh: 你还能说什么呢？

sentences.en: It was one of those moments where you feel so good, you get a little lightheaded.
sentences.zh: 那是一种让你感觉好到有点头晕目眩的时刻。

sentences.en: It's the first moment in time that I can ever remember taking pleasure in somebody else's pain.
sentences.zh: 这是我记忆中第一次从别人的痛苦中感受到快乐。

sentences.en: Reebok, the creator of those Dan and Dave commercials, says that its huge ad campaign isn't dead yet.
sentences.zh: 锐步，那些“丹与戴夫”广告的创作者，表示其庞大的广告宣传活动尚未结束。

sentences.en: It just needs a slight readjustment.
sentences.zh: 只是需要一点微调。

sentences.en: The readjustment came in the form of a new series of ads, embracing the change in the Dan and Dave story.
sentences.zh: 这种微调以一系列新广告的形式出现，顺应了“丹与戴夫”故事中的变化。

sentences.en: Reebok rebooted its campaign on the fly.
sentences.zh: 锐步当机立断重启了他们的宣传活动。

sentences.en: They had new ads out within 48 hours.
sentences.zh: 他们在48小时内就推出了新的广告。

sentences.en: In the coming weeks, there was an ad with Dan coaching Dave.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，出现了一则丹指导戴夫的广告。

sentences.en: Now that I've got some free time, I'm helping Dave train.
sentences.zh: 既然我现在有空，我就在帮戴夫训练。

sentences.en: Faster, Dave!
sentences.zh: 快点，戴夫！

sentences.en: Push it!
sentences.zh: 再加把劲！

sentences.en: One with Dave consoling Dan.
sentences.zh: 还有一则戴夫安慰丹的广告。

sentences.en: Hey, you should be happy.
sentences.zh: 嘿，你应该高兴才对。

sentences.en: You're going to represent your country.
sentences.zh: 你将代表你的国家出征。

sentences.en: You're going for the gold.
sentences.zh: 你要去冲击金牌了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I guess.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我想也是。

sentences.en: I just wish you were going, Dan.
sentences.zh: 我只是希望去的人是你，丹。

sentences.en: And that same ad also announced a new role for Dan O'Brien in Barcelona.
sentences.zh: 而同一则广告也宣布了丹·奥布莱恩在巴塞罗那的新角色。

sentences.en: Dave, I am going.
sentences.zh: 戴夫，我会去的。

sentences.en: Huh?
sentences.zh: 啊？

sentences.en: I'll be up in the broadcast booth.
sentences.zh: 我会在转播间里。

sentences.en: You mean we'll both be in Barcelona?
sentences.zh: 你是说我们俩都会在巴塞罗那？

sentences.en: Uh-huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Together?
sentences.zh: 在一起？

sentences.en: Again?
sentences.zh: 又一次？

sentences.en: Uh-huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: You want a hug?
sentences.zh: 你想抱一下吗？

sentences.en: Nah, we already did that.
sentences.zh: 不了，我们已经抱过了。

sentences.en: Okay, the decathlon resumed this morning at Olympic Stadium.
sentences.zh: 好了，十项全能比赛今天早上在奥林匹克体育场恢复进行。

sentences.en: American Dave Johnson expected to contend for the gold medal.
sentences.zh: 美国选手戴夫·约翰逊有望争夺金牌。

sentences.en: When you're in the broadcast booth, it's really hard not to put yourself out there on the track.
sentences.zh: 当你坐在转播间里时，真的很难不让自己置身于赛道上。

sentences.en: Here are Dwight Stones and the guy who might have been Johnson's toughest competition at the Olympics, Dan O'Brien.
sentences.zh: 这里是德怀特·斯通斯，还有那位本可能是约翰逊在奥运会上最强劲对手的人，丹·奥布莱恩。

sentences.en: It was a little strange, though, looking down there at guys who I thought I could beat for the Olympic gold medal.
sentences.zh: 不过，看着下面那些我认为自己能击败并夺取奥运金牌的选手，感觉还是有点奇怪。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's just really too bad.
sentences.zh: 是啊，这真的很遗憾。

sentences.en: You always hate for it to come down to your third attempt.
sentences.zh: 你总是不希望比赛最后落到要靠第三次试跳来决定胜负。

sentences.en: There were moments when I wasn't horribly complimentary to Dave.
sentences.zh: 有些时候，我对戴夫的评价并不怎么好听。

sentences.en: Well, Dwight, it looks to me like Dave has just lacked enthusiasm all day long.
sentences.zh: 嗯，德怀特，在我看来，戴夫整天都缺乏热情。

sentences.en: And I just saw him struggling.
sentences.zh: 我看着他挣扎的样子。

sentences.en: And I kept thinking, this isn't the Dave Johnson that I saw all spring.
sentences.zh: 我一直在想，这根本不是我整个春天看到的那个戴夫·约翰逊。

sentences.en: This isn't the Dave Johnson that I saw at the Olympic trials.
sentences.zh: 这也不是我在奥运选拔赛上看到的那个戴夫·约翰逊。

sentences.en: And I thought, you know, golly, is he crumbling under the pressure?
sentences.zh: 我心想，天哪，他是不是在压力下崩溃了？

sentences.en: Dave was underperforming, but not because of the pressure.
sentences.zh: 戴夫表现不佳，但并不是因为压力。

sentences.en: His foot injury from the trials had only gotten worse.
sentences.zh: 他在选拔赛中受的脚伤反而加重了。

sentences.en: The public didn't know about it, but a few weeks before the games, Dave had met with a doctor about his foot.
sentences.zh: 公众对此一无所知，但在奥运会前几周，戴夫曾就他的脚伤咨询过医生。

sentences.en: And the doctor said, you can't go.
sentences.zh: 医生说，你不能去。

sentences.en: You shouldn't go to the Olympics because it's going to break in half.
sentences.zh: 你不应该去参加奥运会，因为你的脚会断掉的。

sentences.en: And I'm, wait a minute, I'm the Dave guy from the Reebok commercials.
sentences.zh: 而我心想，等一下，我可是锐步广告里的那个“戴夫”。

sentences.en: And Dan didn't make the team, didn't you see?
sentences.zh: 而且丹没能入选国家队，你没看到吗？

sentences.en: Somebody's got to go.
sentences.zh: 总得有人去吧。

sentences.en: In Barcelona, on a broken foot, starting day two in ninth place, Dave toughed it out and finished third.
sentences.zh: 在巴塞罗那，戴夫带着骨折的脚，在第二天比赛开始时排名第九的情况下，硬撑着完成了比赛，最终获得了第三名。

sentences.en: Dave Johnson becomes the first U.S.
sentences.zh: 戴夫·约翰逊成为继1976年的布鲁斯·詹纳之后，

sentences.en: medalist in the event since Bruce Jenner back in 1976.
sentences.zh: 第一位在该项目中获得奖牌的美国选手。

sentences.en: You know, he did his absolute best, which was phenomenal, to walk away with a bronze medal.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他尽了自己最大的努力，表现非常出色，最终带走了一枚铜牌。

sentences.en: Even as I stepped up and received the bronze medal, you know, and saw the American flag go up,
sentences.zh: 即使当我走上领奖台接过铜牌，看到美国国旗升起时，

sentences.en: I was thinking, man, I'd overcome, you know, this Dan and Dave campaign and the broken foot
sentences.zh: 我还在想，天哪，我克服了“丹与戴夫”的宣传压力，克服了骨折，

sentences.en: and just the career of 14, 15 years of training.
sentences.zh: 还有那14、15年的职业训练生涯。

sentences.en: And I was so fortunate to be able to step down from that medals ceremony and go to the people that really knew me,
sentences.zh: 我非常幸运，能从领奖台上走下来，去见那些真正了解我的人，

sentences.en: my family, my coach, and the people that really were there in my life to get me to that moment.
sentences.zh: 我的家人、我的教练，以及那些在我生命中真正支持我走到这一刻的人。

sentences.en: Dave wins the bronze medal.
sentences.zh: 戴夫赢得了铜牌。

sentences.en: Roberts Mellick comes home with the gold from the Czech Republic.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·梅利克带着来自捷克的金牌回国了。

sentences.en: Like, neither Dave nor I claim the title of the world's greatest athlete in Barcelona.
sentences.zh: 就像这样，在巴塞罗那，我和戴夫谁都没有获得“世界上最伟大运动员”的称号。

sentences.en: And I think it was two or three days later in USA Today,
sentences.zh: 我想大概两三天后，《今日美国》上，

sentences.en: Reebok has a big ad that says congratulations to Dave Johnson for winning the Olympic bronze medal.
sentences.zh: 锐步刊登了一则大广告，祝贺戴夫·约翰逊赢得奥运铜牌。

sentences.en: Thank you, Dan and Dave, for a great year.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们，丹和戴夫，度过了伟大的一年。

sentences.en: And I think for me, at that particular moment, Dan and Dave ended.
sentences.zh: 我想对我来说，在那一刻，“丹与戴夫”结束了。

sentences.en: Dan and Dave was over as an ad campaign.
sentences.zh: “丹与戴夫”作为一项广告宣传活动已经结束了。

sentences.en: And with Dave coming off a major injury, Dan and Dave looked to be over as a major rivalry, too.
sentences.zh: 随着戴夫因重伤退出，“丹与戴夫”作为一场重大竞争似乎也结束了。

sentences.en: But Dan O'Brien was already thinking about what was next.
sentences.zh: 但丹·奥布莱恩已经在思考下一步该做什么了。

sentences.en: All I could do was really think about what was down the road for me.
sentences.zh: 我所能做的就是认真思考我未来的路该怎么走。

sentences.en: And the great thing about track and field is you don't have to wait every four years for a big event.
sentences.zh: 田径运动最棒的地方在于，你不必每四年才等来一次大型赛事。

sentences.en: I knew I was going to get another shot the following year at a world championship.
sentences.zh: 我知道第二年的世界锦标赛我还有机会。

sentences.en: Starting in the fall of 1992, just a few weeks after the Barcelona Games,
sentences.zh: 从1992年秋天开始，就在巴塞罗那奥运会结束几周后，

sentences.en: and for the next few years, Dan O'Brien went on the best tear of his life.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几年里，丹·奥布莱恩开启了他人生中最辉煌的时期。

sentences.en: September that same year, I break the world record.
sentences.zh: 同年9月，我打破了世界纪录。

sentences.en: The winter of 1993, I win the first Peptathlon World Indoor Championships.
sentences.zh: 1993年冬天，我赢得了首届室内田径世锦赛冠军。

sentences.en: I break the world record.
sentences.zh: 我打破了世界纪录。

sentences.en: I win a U.S.
sentences.zh: 我在俄勒冈州尤金市赢得了美国

sentences.en: outdoor title in Eugene, Oregon.
sentences.zh: 室外赛冠军。

sentences.en: Score over 8,800.
sentences.zh: 得分超过8800分。

sentences.en: Go on to defend my world title in Stuttgart, Germany.
sentences.zh: 随后在德国斯图加特成功卫冕世界冠军。

sentences.en: Win a third world outdoor title in Gothenburg, Sweden.
sentences.zh: 在瑞典哥德堡赢得了第三个室外赛世界冠军。

sentences.en: But no one cared.
sentences.zh: 但没人关心。

sentences.en: I remember eating lunch with Bruce Jenner, and Bruce kept telling me,
sentences.zh: 我记得和布鲁斯·詹纳一起吃午饭，布鲁斯一直告诉我，

sentences.en: only thing people are going to remember is the Olympic Games.
sentences.zh: 人们唯一会记住的就是奥运会。

sentences.en: And I thought to myself, man, this guy's crazy.
sentences.zh: 我心想，天哪，这家伙疯了。

sentences.en: He doesn't know what he's talking about.
sentences.zh: 他根本不知道自己在说什么。

sentences.en: He didn't have world championships when he was a competing athlete.
sentences.zh: 他当运动员的时候根本没有世锦赛。

sentences.en: I get to compete at world championships every two years.
sentences.zh: 我每两年就能参加一次世锦赛。

sentences.en: But it wasn't until later that I realized, man, Bruce was right.
sentences.zh: 但直到后来我才意识到，天哪，布鲁斯是对的。

sentences.en: So Dan O'Brien set his sights on the next Olympics and the chance to win a medal people would care about.
sentences.zh: 于是丹·奥布莱恩将目光投向了下一届奥运会，争取赢得一枚人们真正关心的奖牌。

sentences.en: But even as he was winning meet after meet, Dan felt he needed help because he was still struggling with the mental side of the decathlon.
sentences.zh: 但即使在不断赢得比赛的同时，丹也觉得他需要帮助，因为他仍在与十项全能的心理压力作斗争。

sentences.en: I used to get so nervous before I competed that I would question why I'd do this, almost throwing up, wanting to quit.
sentences.zh: 我以前在比赛前总是紧张到怀疑自己为什么要这么做，几乎要呕吐，甚至想放弃。

sentences.en: My name is Dr. Jim Reardon.
sentences.zh: 我叫吉姆·里尔登医生。

sentences.en: I'm a sports psychologist from Columbus, Ohio.
sentences.zh: 我是来自俄亥俄州哥伦布市的一名运动心理学家。

sentences.en: Dan had come to Dr. Reardon to talk about that anxiety he faced before every competition.
sentences.zh: 丹来找里尔登医生，谈论他每次比赛前所面临的焦虑。

sentences.en: But Dr. Reardon suspected there was a deeper element at play, the fallout from the missed pole vault in New Orleans.
sentences.zh: 但里尔登医生怀疑背后还有更深层的原因，即新奥尔良撑杆跳失误后的后遗症。

sentences.en: What can happen is people come in for treatment from trauma, and the first thing the therapist wants to talk about is the trauma.
sentences.zh: 可能会发生的情况是，人们因为创伤来寻求治疗，而治疗师最想谈论的往往就是创伤本身。

sentences.en: And the last thing the person wants to talk about is the trauma.
sentences.zh: 而当事人最不想谈论的恰恰也是创伤。

sentences.en: I just made the decision pretty early on, if he brings it up and wants to talk about it, we'll talk about it.
sentences.zh: 我早早就做出了决定，如果他提起并想谈论这件事，我们就谈。

sentences.en: But if he doesn't, then we won't because he'll know when the time will be right.
sentences.zh: 但如果他不提，那我们就不谈，因为他自己会知道什么时候才是合适的时机。

sentences.en: And so we didn't.
sentences.zh: 所以我们一直没谈。

sentences.en: For almost three years, the pole vault miss didn't come up.
sentences.zh: 近三年来，撑杆跳失误的事从未被提起过。

sentences.en: They talked about other parts of the decathlon, their personal lives, the real world, but never New Orleans.
sentences.zh: 他们谈论十项全能的其他部分、他们的个人生活、现实世界，但从未谈及新奥尔良。

sentences.en: Until one day in August 1995.
sentences.zh: 直到1995年8月的一天。

sentences.en: 311 days until the next Olympic trials.
sentences.zh: 距离下一次奥运选拔赛还有311天。

sentences.en: We were having this conversation, and he kind of started it out by saying, gosh, you know what, last night was weird.
sentences.zh: 我们当时正在聊天，他开头说，天哪，你知道吗，昨晚真奇怪。

sentences.en: I had a dream about the pole vault from 1992.
sentences.zh: 我梦到了1992年的那次撑杆跳。

sentences.en: He said, I haven't thought about that in years.
sentences.zh: 他说，我已经好几年没想过那件事了。

sentences.en: And I'm thinking to myself, okay, I guess this is the moment.
sentences.zh: 我心想，好吧，我想这就是那个时刻了。

sentences.en: Over the coming months, Reardon decided that he had to take a big, aggressive step.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，里尔登决定他必须采取一个重大且激进的步骤。

sentences.en: Dan had to watch footage of his failure in New Orleans.
sentences.zh: 丹必须观看他在新奥尔良失败的录像。

sentences.en: Somebody got me a copy of it.
sentences.zh: 有人帮我弄到了录像副本。

sentences.en: And I had a couple of, back in those days, DVDs made.
sentences.zh: 在那个年代，我让人做了几张DVD。

sentences.en: I kind of caught him off guard.
sentences.zh: 我算是打了他个措手不及。

sentences.en: And I said, I got something I want you to look at.
sentences.zh: 我说，我有样东西想让你看看。

sentences.en: And we watched it.
sentences.zh: 于是我们看了录像。

sentences.en: He's watching it, and I'm watching him.
sentences.zh: 他在看录像，而我在观察他。

sentences.en: It was ghastly.
sentences.zh: 那真是太可怕了。

sentences.en: It brought back all the feelings that I had in 1992.
sentences.zh: 它勾起了我1992年所有的感受。

sentences.en: I remembered seeing the white t-shirts, Dan or Dave t-shirts in the crowd.
sentences.zh: 我记得看到人群中那些白色的T恤，那些印着“丹或戴夫”的T恤。

sentences.en: I remember what side of the field I was on and how hot it was.
sentences.zh: 我记得我当时站在赛场的哪一边，记得当时有多热。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh, it was hot.
sentences.zh: 天哪，真是太热了。

sentences.en: And I remember thinking to myself, holy mackerel.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时心想，天哪，糟糕透了。

sentences.en: I relived the horror of missing on a third attempt.
sentences.zh: 我重温了第三次试跳失败的恐惧。

sentences.en: And coming down, landing on the pit, and just being in a complete daze.
sentences.zh: 落地，掉进海绵坑，整个人完全处于恍惚状态。

sentences.en: And it was absolutely ghastly to go through those emotions again.
sentences.zh: 再次经历那些情绪简直太可怕了。

sentences.en: This is it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: He's not on the team.
sentences.zh: 他没能入选国家队。

sentences.en: The video continued to roll.
sentences.zh: 录像继续播放。

sentences.en: It showed Dave come over to hug me.
sentences.zh: 画面显示戴夫走过来拥抱我。

sentences.en: I couldn't, I couldn't, I didn't even know what to say afterwards.
sentences.zh: 我当时根本不知道该说什么。

sentences.en: And I said, what do you think?
sentences.zh: 我问他，你觉得怎么样？

sentences.en: And he said, I don't want to look at this.
sentences.zh: 他说，我不想看这个。

sentences.en: And I said, okay.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧。

sentences.en: And then I replayed it.
sentences.zh: 然后我又重放了一遍。

sentences.en: And I said, what do you think?
sentences.zh: 我说，你觉得怎么样？

sentences.en: And he said, I, he said, I feel like, I feel like throwing up.
sentences.zh: 他说，我，他说，我觉得，我觉得想吐。

sentences.en: And I said, I said, you know what?
sentences.zh: 我说，我说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I would much rather have you feel like that in a hotel room in Chula Vista in December
sentences.zh: 我宁愿你现在在12月的丘拉维斯塔酒店房间里有这种感觉，

sentences.en: than on the runway in Atlanta in June.
sentences.zh: 也不愿你在6月亚特兰大的赛道上才有这种感觉。

sentences.en: I wanted him to get to the point where he would have seen that video so many times
sentences.zh: 我想让他达到一个境界，就是他已经看过那段录像无数次，

sentences.en: that he would just get pissed off when he would think about it.
sentences.zh: 以至于当他再想到它时，只会感到愤怒。

sentences.en: And develop the mindset that pressure is nothing.
sentences.zh: 并建立起一种心态：压力算什么。

sentences.en: Pressure is going to bring out the best in me.
sentences.zh: 压力只会激发我最好的状态。

sentences.en: It's a trials doubleheader today, folks.
sentences.zh: 各位，今天是选拔赛的双重赛程。

sentences.en: Hello, I'm Bob Costas.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是鲍勃·科斯塔斯。

sentences.en: We have competition from track and field here at the Olympic Stadium in Atlanta.
sentences.zh: 我们现在在亚特兰大的奥林匹克体育场进行田径比赛。

sentences.en: And from Indiana.
sentences.zh: 还有来自印第安纳州的比赛。

sentences.en: The trials for the 1996 Olympics were held in Atlanta, which would be the site of the
sentences.zh: 1996年奥运会的选拔赛在亚特兰大举行，那里将是

sentences.en: games themselves later that summer.
sentences.zh: 那年夏天晚些时候的比赛。

sentences.en: And once again, the decathlon competition featured two familiar faces, Dan O'Brien and
sentences.zh: 十项全能比赛再次出现了两张熟悉的面孔，丹·奥布莱恩和

sentences.en: Dave Johnson.
sentences.zh: 戴夫·约翰逊。

sentences.en: But no one was talking about Dan and Dave in 1996.
sentences.zh: 但在1996年，没人再谈论丹和戴夫了。

sentences.en: No Reebok campaign.
sentences.zh: 没有锐步的广告宣传。

sentences.en: In fact, Dan was a Nike athlete by this point.
sentences.zh: 事实上，那时候丹已经是耐克的运动员了。

sentences.en: And Dave was living the typical battle of the injured athlete, one problem piling up on top
sentences.zh: 而戴夫正经历着受伤运动员典型的挣扎，一个问题接着一个问题地

sentences.en: of another.
sentences.zh: 堆积而来。

sentences.en: These trials were not about who would be the world's greatest athlete, Dan or Dave.
sentences.zh: 这次选拔赛不再是关于谁会成为世界上最伟大的运动员，丹还是戴夫。

sentences.en: The storyline was all Dan O'Brien.
sentences.zh: 故事的主角完全是丹·奥布莱恩。

sentences.en: Well, Tom, I would say that the 1992 Olympic trials debacle by Dan O'Brien is a part of track
sentences.zh: 嗯，汤姆，我想说丹·奥布莱恩在1992年奥运选拔赛上的惨败，现在已经成为田径界

sentences.en: and field lore and legend at this point.
sentences.zh: 的传说和轶事了。

sentences.en: I was nervous going into the 96 trials, I'll be honest with you.
sentences.zh: 老实说，参加96年选拔赛时我很紧张。

sentences.en: I can remember waking up the morning that the decathlon started.
sentences.zh: 我记得十项全能开始的那天早上，我醒了过来。

sentences.en: I put my head in my wife's lap and just sobbed because I was nervous and I was scared, you
sentences.zh: 我把头埋在妻子的膝盖上痛哭，因为我感到紧张和害怕，你知道，

sentences.en: know, but I needed to get that out.
sentences.zh: 但我需要把这种情绪发泄出来。

sentences.en: I think every decathlete who competes now is affected by his no height in the pole vault
sentences.zh: 我想现在每一位参赛的十项全能选手，都受到他四年前撑杆跳没有成绩的影响。

sentences.en: four years ago.
sentences.zh: 四年前。

sentences.en: I would submit that this will be the hardest track meet that Dan O'Brien will ever compete
sentences.zh: 我认为这将是丹·奥布莱恩参加过的最艰难的田径比赛。

sentences.en: in.
sentences.zh: 在。

sentences.en: Even if Dan had felt like he'd put 1992 behind him, the organizers in Atlanta wouldn't let
sentences.zh: 即使丹觉得他已经把1992年的阴影抛在脑后，亚特兰大的组织者也不会让他

sentences.en: him shake it so easily.
sentences.zh: 轻易摆脱。

sentences.en: And I'll never forget, as I walked out to run the 100 meters, the start of the very first
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记，当我走上赛道准备跑100米时，那是亚特兰大奥运选拔赛的第一天，

sentences.en: day at the Atlanta Olympic trials, I look up at the big screen on the north end of the
sentences.zh: 我抬头看向场地北端的大屏幕，

sentences.en: side of the field and they're showing my failure in the pole vault.
sentences.zh: 他们正在播放我撑杆跳失败的画面。

sentences.en: When I saw that footage, I was pissed off.
sentences.zh: 当我看到那段录像时，我气坏了。

sentences.en: I don't even know to this day whose idea it was.
sentences.zh: 直到今天，我甚至不知道那是谁的主意。

sentences.en: It really didn't upset me that I saw the video.
sentences.zh: 看到那段视频其实并没有让我难过。

sentences.en: I kind of almost chuckled.
sentences.zh: 我反而差点笑出声来。

sentences.en: I laughed it off.
sentences.zh: 我一笑置之。

sentences.en: Because of the training that Dan had done, it became just nothing.
sentences.zh: 因为丹所做的训练，那已经不算什么了。

sentences.en: I was ready.
sentences.zh: 我准备好了。

sentences.en: Proving he was ready, Dan got off to a great start.
sentences.zh: 为了证明他准备好了，丹开局非常出色。

sentences.en: Going into day two, he was in second place, and he'd remain there through the hurdles and
sentences.zh: 进入第二天，他排在第二位，并且在跨栏和

sentences.en: the discus.
sentences.zh: 铁饼比赛中保持住了这个位置。

sentences.en: And with seven of the ten events complete, next, the dreaded pole vault.
sentences.zh: 在十项比赛完成了七项之后，接下来是令人畏惧的撑杆跳。

sentences.en: What must be going through his mind?
sentences.zh: 他心里在想什么呢？

sentences.en: I get a little nervous and, you know, just I'm tired of sitting around.
sentences.zh: 我有点紧张，你知道，我只是厌倦了干坐着。

sentences.en: 20 minutes has gone by, maybe a half hour since I took my last warm-up jump.
sentences.zh: 距离我上一次热身跳已经过去了20分钟，也许半小时了。

sentences.en: Dan was cooling off, and just like in 1992, he was losing his rhythm.
sentences.zh: 丹的身体正在冷却，就像1992年一样，他正在失去节奏。

sentences.en: So he made a last-minute decision to change his strategy.
sentences.zh: 所以他临时决定改变策略。

sentences.en: Two bars before I'm supposed to come in, I get a little antsy.
sentences.zh: 在预定起跳高度前两档时，我有点坐不住了。

sentences.en: And I walked over to my coach, Rick Sloan, and I said,
sentences.zh: 我走到我的教练里克·斯隆身边，我说，

sentences.en: what do you think about me coming in at the next bar?
sentences.zh: 你觉得我下一档就上怎么样？

sentences.en: It was a scheduled bar lower than I was supposed to come in, and he's just like,
sentences.zh: 那比我原定的起跳高度还要低，他只是说，

sentences.en: you feel good?
sentences.zh: 你感觉好吗？

sentences.en: Go for it.
sentences.zh: 那就上吧。

sentences.en: Do it.
sentences.zh: 去做吧。

sentences.en: I didn't tell anybody else.
sentences.zh: 我没告诉其他人。

sentences.en: I looked at my coach, and all of a sudden, I took my sweats off,
sentences.zh: 我看着我的教练，突然脱掉运动服，

sentences.en: and I step up to the runway, and they say, O'Brien, up.
sentences.zh: 走上助跑道，他们喊道：奥布莱恩，请上场。

sentences.en: And I think that surprised even my competitors at the time.
sentences.zh: 我想这在当时甚至让我的竞争对手都感到惊讶。

sentences.en: Well, Tom, they made one intelligent decision.
sentences.zh: 嗯，汤姆，他们做了一个明智的决定。

sentences.en: They're starting at a height one foot below what Dan started at four years ago,
sentences.zh: 他们起跳的高度比丹四年前开始的高度低了一英尺，

sentences.en: and everyone in the stadium holding their collective breath.
sentences.zh: 体育场里的每个人都屏住了呼吸。

sentences.en: I'm on the runway.
sentences.zh: 我站在助跑道上。

sentences.en: I got my starter pole.
sentences.zh: 我拿到了我的起跳杆。

sentences.en: Don't even think about missing.
sentences.zh: 连想都不要想会失败。

sentences.en: Just think, you know what?
sentences.zh: 只要想，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I'm here at a vault.
sentences.zh: 我在这儿跳一次。

sentences.en: Head down the runway and think to myself, look, I'm probably not as warmed up as I should be.
sentences.zh: 我沿着助跑道跑去，心想，看，我可能没热身到应有的程度。

sentences.en: I push a little harder than I normally would on a first attempt jump.
sentences.zh: 我在第一次试跳时比平时更用力了一些。

sentences.en: As I take off the ground, my top hand slips about an inch, and I re-grip real quick.
sentences.zh: 当我起跳时，我的上手滑了大约一英寸，我迅速重新抓稳。

sentences.en: Swing up, go over the bar, and I got a first attempt make.
sentences.zh: 摆动身体，越过横杆，我第一次试跳就成功了。

sentences.en: That's kind of like hitting the lottery.
sentences.zh: 那感觉就像中了彩票一样。

sentences.en: And by virtue of that first attempt make, I'm on the team.
sentences.zh: 凭借那次一次性成功，我入选了国家队。

sentences.en: Here is the sweet irony for O'Brien.
sentences.zh: 这就是奥布莱恩身上美妙的讽刺之处。

sentences.en: It looks like Dan O'Brien is going to gain the lead in the decathlon
sentences.zh: 看起来丹·奥布莱恩要在十项全能中取得领先了，

sentences.en: because of his performance here in the pole vault,
sentences.zh: 正是因为他在撑杆跳中的表现，

sentences.en: the event that was his undoing four years ago.
sentences.zh: 而这正是他四年前失败的项目。

sentences.en: A few hours later, Dan would finish first in the trials decathlon,
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，丹在选拔赛的十项全能中获得了第一名，

sentences.en: a stark contrast to four years earlier.
sentences.zh: 与四年前形成了鲜明的对比。

sentences.en: In 1992, it had been Dave Johnson watching Dan struggle.
sentences.zh: 1992年，是戴夫·约翰逊看着丹挣扎。

sentences.en: This time, the roles were reversed.
sentences.zh: 这一次，角色互换了。

sentences.en: I ended up placing sixth and pretty much knew that was my retirement
sentences.zh: 我最终获得了第六名，在那项比赛之后，在那次奥运选拔赛之后，

sentences.en: after that event, after that Olympic trials.
sentences.zh: 我基本上就知道那是我的退役之战了。

sentences.en: I just remember just being able to encourage Dan to go on in Atlanta
sentences.zh: 我只记得当时能够鼓励丹继续在亚特兰大前进，

sentences.en: and represent the United States.
sentences.zh: 并代表美国参赛。

sentences.en: And here comes Dan O'Brien.
sentences.zh: 丹·奥布莱恩来了。

sentences.en: Let's let the crowd carry him home here.
sentences.zh: 让观众们把他送向终点吧。

sentences.en: He is finally going to make a U.S.
sentences.zh: 他终于要进入美国

sentences.en: Olympic team.
sentences.zh: 奥运代表队了。

sentences.en: Dan O'Brien was world champion, record holder.
sentences.zh: 丹·奥布莱恩是世界冠军，纪录保持者。

sentences.en: He'd exercised the demons of New Orleans.
sentences.zh: 他已经驱散了新奥尔良的梦魇。

sentences.en: Now the only job left to do was to win the gold six weeks later.
sentences.zh: 现在剩下的唯一任务就是六周后赢得金牌。

sentences.en: The trouble is when you've won everything except for the Olympic gold medal
sentences.zh: 问题是，当你赢得了除了奥运金牌以外的一切，

sentences.en: and you feel like it's the last thing on your list,
sentences.zh: 并且觉得这是你清单上的最后一项时，

sentences.en: it's not as exciting as it could be.
sentences.zh: 它可能并没有那么令人兴奋。

sentences.en: It was stressful.
sentences.zh: 那压力很大。

sentences.en: I was trying to just not make mistakes.
sentences.zh: 我只是尽量不犯错。

sentences.en: Atlanta's Olympic Stadium, where the decathlon competition continued today.
sentences.zh: 亚特兰大奥林匹克体育场，十项全能比赛今天继续进行。

sentences.en: And for a report on day two in the decathlon, let's go to Dwight Stones.
sentences.zh: 关于十项全能第二天的报道，让我们连线德怀特·斯通斯。

sentences.en: In Atlanta, in his quest to finally settle that question,
sentences.zh: 在亚特兰大，为了最终解决那个问题，

sentences.en: who is the world's greatest athlete that had first been asked four years earlier,
sentences.zh: 即四年前首次提出的“谁是世界上最伟大的运动员”，

sentences.en: Dan O'Brien's first day of competition went off without a hitch.
sentences.zh: 丹·奥布莱恩的第一天比赛进行得非常顺利。

sentences.en: As prepared as I was for the Olympic Games,
sentences.zh: 尽管我为奥运会做了充分的准备，

sentences.en: sometimes what you're not prepared for is what other people are going to do.
sentences.zh: 但有时你无法准备的是别人会做什么。

sentences.en: This crazy young guy from Germany, Frank Boosman, this young kid,
sentences.zh: 这个来自德国的疯狂年轻人，弗兰克·布斯曼，这个小伙子，

sentences.en: he had personal best after personal beSt.
sentences.zh: 他不断刷新个人最好成绩。

sentences.en: He was going crazy.
sentences.zh: 他简直疯了。

sentences.en: So, on this new stage, Dan suddenly had a new rival.
sentences.zh: 所以，在这个新舞台上，丹突然有了一个新对手。

sentences.en: Boosman, the German, was right on his heels.
sentences.zh: 德国人布斯曼紧追不舍。

sentences.en: Through day one, through the pole vault, and right up to the decathlon's final two events,
sentences.zh: 经过第一天，经过撑杆跳，一直到十项全能的最后两项，

sentences.en: the javelin and the 1500 meters, a race that had never been Dan's strongeSt.
sentences.zh: 标枪和1500米，这从来都不是丹的强项。

sentences.en: I need a big lead before the 1500 meters.
sentences.zh: 在1500米之前我需要很大的领先优势。

sentences.en: And when I got to the javelin, I didn't have as big a lead as I would have liked.
sentences.zh: 当我进行标枪比赛时，我的领先优势并没有我希望的那么大。

sentences.en: He was a little too close for comfort.
sentences.zh: 他离我太近了，让我感到不安。

sentences.en: Let's head back to the track.
sentences.zh: 让我们回到赛道。

sentences.en: The two-day decathlon concluding tonight with a report on how...
sentences.zh: 为期两天的十项全能今晚结束，报道关于如何……

sentences.en: And so as I got into the javelin, it was the twilight of the night.
sentences.zh: 当我开始标枪比赛时，已经是夜幕降临了。

sentences.en: The Olympic Stadium was packed, with hometown American fans rooting on Dan
sentences.zh: 奥林匹克体育场座无虚席，家乡的美国球迷在为丹加油，

sentences.en: and a noisy contingent of Germans rooting on Boosman.
sentences.zh: 还有一群吵闹的德国人在为布斯曼助威。

sentences.en: Each of the competitors selected a javelin and took their first throw.
sentences.zh: 每位选手都挑选了一支标枪，并进行了第一次投掷。

sentences.en: Dan's first attempt was disappointing.
sentences.zh: 丹的第一次尝试令人失望。

sentences.en: But he tried to stay calm, scanning the crowd as he waited his next turn.
sentences.zh: 但他努力保持冷静，在等待下一次轮次时扫视着人群。

sentences.en: I look over and see a guy in a red, white, and blue jersey, USA jersey, and it's Dave Johnson.
sentences.zh: 我抬头看到一个穿着红白蓝球衣、美国队球衣的人，是戴夫·约翰逊。

sentences.en: He's got his Oakleys on the back of his head, backwards like he always used to wear them.
sentences.zh: 他戴着奥克利眼镜，像他以前总是戴的那样，反戴在脑后。

sentences.en: And he was down in the front row, you know, just kind of hanging.
sentences.zh: 他坐在前排，你知道，只是在那儿待着。

sentences.en: Dave had been standing with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 戴夫一直和美国队教练站在一起，

sentences.en: coaches, quietly watching the drama play out.
sentences.zh: 静静地看着比赛的进展。

sentences.en: But now, he was noticing something.
sentences.zh: 但现在，他注意到了什么。

sentences.en: As Dan threw his first throw, I think I could tell the javelin he was throwing
sentences.zh: 当丹进行第一次投掷时，我想我能看出他投的那支标枪，

sentences.en: wasn't flying exactly as well as it should be for his type of throwing.
sentences.zh: 飞行效果并不完全符合他那种投掷方式的要求。

sentences.en: After the second throw, another disappointment,
sentences.zh: 第二次投掷后，又是一次失望，

sentences.en: Dan came over to consult with his coaches on the sidelines,
sentences.zh: 丹走到场边咨询他的教练，

sentences.en: with Dave standing right nearby.
sentences.zh: 戴夫就站在附近。

sentences.en: And we had that eye contact.
sentences.zh: 我们有了眼神交流。

sentences.en: And I say to Dave, which javelin should I use?
sentences.zh: 我对戴夫说，我该用哪支标枪？

sentences.en: You've got a hundred to choose from out there.
sentences.zh: 那儿有一百支供你选择。

sentences.en: I had him pick out the javelin that I knew would work really well,
sentences.zh: 我让他帮我挑出那支我知道会非常好用的标枪，

sentences.en: you know, because the javelin is just my best event.
sentences.zh: 你知道，因为标枪是我最擅长的项目。

sentences.en: Dave said, the 90-meter Nemeth.
sentences.zh: 戴夫说，90米的内梅特标枪。

sentences.en: And I knew exactly which javelin he was talking about.
sentences.zh: 我完全知道他说的是哪一支。

sentences.en: And I said, all right.
sentences.zh: 我说，好的。

sentences.en: Something about him being there, it put me at ease.
sentences.zh: 他在那儿让我感到安心。

sentences.en: It was just refreshing to my soul.
sentences.zh: 这让我的灵魂感到焕然一新。

sentences.en: I just felt good that he was going to be there to witness my greatest moment.
sentences.zh: 他能在那儿见证我最伟大的时刻，我感到很高兴。

sentences.en: Dano stepped up to the line for his third throw.
sentences.zh: 丹诺走上起投线进行第三次投掷。

sentences.en: Needs a cushion for the 1500s.
sentences.zh: 他需要为1500米比赛争取缓冲空间。

sentences.en: Maybe in my mind, I might have stepped out of myself and went out into his body a little bit.
sentences.zh: 也许在我的脑海里，我可能已经跳出了自己，进入了他的身体里一点点。

sentences.en: And I got to be Dan for about 20 seconds and help him throw that thing.
sentences.zh: 我有大约20秒的时间成为了丹，并帮他投出了那一枪。

sentences.en: Never spoken.
sentences.zh: 从未言说。

sentences.en: Dan O'Brien is on the brink.
sentences.zh: 丹·奥布莱恩处于巅峰边缘。

sentences.en: I'm going to win an Olympic gold medal.
sentences.zh: 我要赢得奥运金牌了。

sentences.en: Dan O'Brien showing the courage of a world champion and an Olympic champion is picking it up.
sentences.zh: 丹·奥布莱恩展现了世界冠军和奥运冠军的勇气，正在奋起直追。

sentences.en: When Dan won a gold medal in 96, I was just glad that it came full circle for him.
sentences.zh: 当丹在96年赢得金牌时，我只是很高兴他终于圆满了。

sentences.en: Being able to go through, but stick through and not give up on the sport.
sentences.zh: 能够坚持到底，不放弃这项运动。

sentences.en: And it was great to see him finally being an Olympic champion.
sentences.zh: 看到他最终成为奥运冠军真是太棒了。

sentences.en: I think it would be tough to talk about Dan and Dave if I hadn't come back in 96 and won the gold.
sentences.zh: 我想如果我没有在96年回归并赢得金牌，谈论丹和戴夫会很困难。

sentences.en: But I think failing in 1992 gave me an opportunity to rewrite the narrative.
sentences.zh: 但我认为1992年的失败给了我重写故事的机会。

sentences.en: I had to change people's minds every time I stepped out onto the track.
sentences.zh: 每次我踏上赛道，都必须去改变人们对我的看法。

sentences.en: People, when they think of Dan and Dave, they remember something went wrong.
sentences.zh: 人们一提到丹和戴夫，就会想起出了岔子的事。

sentences.en: Reebok, they had this big campaign that we both were going to be at the Olympics.
sentences.zh: 锐步当时搞了个大型宣传活动，说我们俩都会参加奥运会。

sentences.en: And then only one of us went, so it was a failure because of that.
sentences.zh: 结果只有一个人去了，所以从那个角度看，这成了一次失败。

sentences.en: But the reality of that situation is the campaign was a huge success.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，那次宣传活动其实非常成功。

sentences.en: They sold more shoes of that particular running cross trainer shoe than any other shoe throughout the year and a half that they were promoting it.
sentences.zh: 在他们推广那款特定的跑步交叉训练鞋的一年半时间里，它的销量超过了其他任何鞋款。

sentences.en: That whole year was such a great experience, except for two hours on the second day in the eighth event of the decathlon.
sentences.zh: 那一整年都是一段很棒的经历，除了十项全能第八项比赛第二天的那两个小时。

sentences.en: I meet people who say, I remember where I was when you didn't make that third attempt in the pole vault.
sentences.zh: 我遇到过一些人，他们说：我还记得你撑杆跳第三次试跳失败时我在哪儿。

sentences.en: They have where were they stories when Dan O'Brien didn't make the Olympic team.
sentences.zh: 当丹·奥布莱恩没能入选奥运代表队时，人们都有属于自己的“当时我在哪儿”的故事。

sentences.en: And I think that's just in our human nature.
sentences.zh: 我想这大概就是人性吧。

sentences.en: We are just programmed to remember the bad times a little bit better than the good times.
sentences.zh: 我们天生就比记住美好时光更容易记住糟糕的时刻。

sentences.en: People remember the field goal that was missed.
sentences.zh: 人们记得的是那个没踢进的射门。

sentences.en: People remember the free throws that the guy didn't make.
sentences.zh: 人们记得的是那个球员没投进的罚球。

sentences.en: Nothing prepares you for, you know, really having your dream just kind of slip out from underneath you.
sentences.zh: 没有什么能让你做好准备，去面对梦想从你脚下溜走的那种感觉。

sentences.en: But a personality, a great performance can change an athlete's life.
sentences.zh: 但一个鲜明的个性、一场精彩的表现，可以改变一名运动员的一生。

sentences.en: To be settled in Barcelona.
sentences.zh: 在巴塞罗那尘埃落定。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible is a project of Radiotopia and KALW in San Francisco and produced on Radio Row in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 《99% Invisible》是 Radiotopia 和旧金山 KALW 的一个项目，在加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心美丽的 Radio Row 制作。

sentences.en: You can find the show and join discussions about the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 Facebook 上找到该节目并参与讨论。

sentences.en: You can tweet at me, at Roman Mars, in the show, at 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 你可以在推特上 @我（Roman Mars），或者在 99pi.org 上找到节目。

sentences.en: We're on Instagram, Tumblr, and Reddit, too.
sentences.zh: 我们也在 Instagram、Tumblr 和 Reddit 上。

sentences.en: But if you've always wondered what those big two-digit codes painted on airport runways meant, you can find the answer on our website at 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 如果你一直好奇机场跑道上画的那些两位数代码是什么意思，可以在我们的网站 99pi.org 上找到答案。

sentences.en: Radiotopia.
sentences.zh: Radiotopia。
